case.name: group_limit_after_points
case.sql: SELECT count(*),sum(x) FROM (SELECT sum(x) AS x FROM (SELECT length(t.payload) AS x,t.seq AS seq,t.grp AS grp FROM t WHERE (t.grp=8 OR t.seq%8=0)) GROUP BY grp ORDER BY grp ASC LIMIT 8 OFFSET 8);
case.prepare: WITH RECURSIVE c(i) AS (VALUES(1) UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM c WHERE i<1000) SELECT sum((SELECT v FROM t WHERE id=printf('%016x', 1+(c.i*2654435761)%65536))) FROM c;
